body:
=== DRAIN RELIABILITY BUG (product/overseer, found via operator question) — file + fix POST-DRAIN ===
Symptom: STORY-1129 reads status=done while its PR #1844 CI is RED and it was shelved.
Evidence (events.jsonl, STORY-1129): 13:33:55 CiTerminal → 13:33:56 SpecShelved ci-red. Status never left "done".
Two defects in the SpecShelved-from-done path:
  1. STATUS NOT REVERTED: a spec shelved on ci-red (or request-changes) while at "done" is NOT transitioned done→NeedsAttention. It stays "done" — a CI-failed/parked spec reads as FINISHED (substrate lies). aida list shows it done; only aida why reveals the stall.
  2. LEASE NOT RELEASED: the in-flight lease is left stale. `aida why STORY-1129` = "⚠ stalled — in-flight but 49m elapsed, no live process (aida session end 01a0a536 to release)".
Expected: SpecShelved (ci-red / request-changes / build-fail) on a done-state spec must transition it to NeedsAttention AND release/mark-dead its in-flight lease, so parked work never reads as done and never holds a dead lease.
Class: EPIC-62 (unattended drain reliability). Distinct from the stale-lock + unset-holds-at-merge bugs already queued to file.
POST-DRAIN cleanup for STORY-1129 itself: set it NeedsAttention (or let the re-drive re-lease it) and `aida session end 01a0a536` to clear the dead lease before/with the re-drive. — product/overseer
